epic-teams-t6.title: T6: Polish & Launch
epic-teams-t6.description: Team dashboard (presence, health analytics, activity feed), Project Health Dashboard, cross-project search, anomaly detection, session summaries, onboarding intelligence, review insights, enterprise tier (SSO/SAML, audit logs), and documentation + launch materials. Final Teams phase before GA.

wf-ea2c59c1.title: WogiFlow Deep Optimization
wf-ea2c59c1.description: Config consolidation (108→35 keys, 47KB→15KB) + optimized memory system + function dedup + hook performance

wf-12cc534a.title: Fix All Hardcoded Architecture Assumptions
wf-12cc534a.description: Fix 30 instances of hardcoded assumptions across 10 stories: validation hook, package manager, source root, ESLint flat config, test runners, CSS frameworks, TypeScript conditional, git guards, browser tests, and framework detection expansion

wf-eda35519.title: WogiFlow Auto-Testing Suite
wf-eda35519.description: Comprehensive auto-testing system: auto-generates tests from specs, UI testing via Playwright MCP, API testing via direct HTTP, data integrity chain (API↔UI), /wogi-test command, and quality gate integration. Conditional/opt-in — auto-detected during onboarding, zero overhead when disabled.

wf-e90881f4.title: Production-Grade Verification System
wf-e90881f4.description: Overhaul WogiFlow task completion verification to be dynamic, stack-agnostic, and production-ready. Three pillars: Smart Test Discovery with SWE-bench dual-gate model, auto-detected Verification Profiles per project, and Orchestrated Verification Scenarios replacing curl chains with declarative stateful test flows.

epic-oss-hardening.title: OSS Release Hardening
epic-oss-hardening.description: 5 production readiness improvements: version compat check, interactive config command, manifest-based safe uninstall, unified hook error handling
